prompt:
Edit the supplied portrait image into the EARLY OPENING camera view of the SAME Babylonian fantasy city. Keep 9:16 portrait framing, the same warm late afternoon photographic lighting, the same cobalt blue gate design, the same stepped ziggurat shape and blue shrine, identical materials and architecture. Change ONLY viewpoint and occlusion, making the camera much LOWER behind a low natural earth rise OUTSIDE the city so we are just beginning to see the city appear above the earth horizon.

The major compositional correction is mandatory: a gently irregular EARTH RIDGELINE runs across the frame at about 50% of image height and COMPLETELY HIDES THE CITY BELOW IT. The entire bottom half is softly out-of-focus nearby ochre earth, pebbles, a few sparse low reeds. NO canal, bridge, gate doorway, city streets or temple lower terraces visible. The wall bases and most buildings are entirely blocked by opaque foreground earth. Above this ridge, only the TOP 15–20% of the familiar blue gate towers peeks out on the LEFT/MIDDLE, and the TOP TWO receding tiers and blue shrine of the distant ziggurat rise above the earth skyline on the RIGHT. Ziggurat top around y=30%, gate tower tips around y=44%. A few tiny palm crowns break the skyline. This is a restrained first glimpse of a city from ground-near height, NOT a complete elevated overview. The viewer should feel the city is about to emerge as the camera rises. Do not move or levitate the city itself.

The sky occupies the upper third to half, pale blue with subtle warm clouds; subdued, luminous, not dramatic. City structures small and sharply enough resolved to recognize blue glaze and warm brick; nearest earth softly blurred, skyline readable, no heavy blur stripe. Long lens compression, realistic photographic miniature materials. There are no mountains, no giant sand dunes. No dragon and ALL fires/beacons unlit. No text, borders, labels, UI, collage or additional buildings of other styles. Preserve the city identity. This frame is the beginning of a continuous reveal, so withholding most of the city is intentional.
